Diablo IV equipment-load guide

Game: Diablo IV.

Game: Diablo IV. This Diablo IV guide discusses equipment, character status and how to avoid heavy rolling in a community-created challenge. It does not describe Elden Ring equipment-load rules or a Limgrave build. A character can inspect equipped armor before entering a dungeon. No statement on this page establishes any Elden Ring game ownership or applicability.
